waterAreas.geometryNote: OSM multipolygon outer/inner loops; loops are source geometry and not field-surveyed.

sources.dimensionsAccuracy: photo-guided artistic approximation; widths and heights are not measured
sources.roadSelection: all source public walking highways inside bounds: footway/pedestrian/path plus walkable service/alley/residential/living_street/unclassified; private/no/customers and parking_aisle excluded
sources.bridgeSelection: every selected bridge=yes way has an independent entry; only the three established bridges retain photo-confirmed profiles; other types remain schematic
sources.waterSelection: all selected canal/stream ways and closed natural=water polygons in the old-town bbox, plus OSM relation 62435 outer/inner loops
sources.landPathSelection: only non-bridge roads near a water-width approximation without a source centre-line crossing; source crossings are retained as unresolved annotations
sources.coverageNote: Expanded old-town public-street skeleton; northern Aidu area is not inferred beyond source ways inside bounds.
sources.bridgeDimensionNote: 富安桥官方页面给出长17.4m、宽3.8m、孔径6.6m；OSM位置与官网尺寸未作测绘融合，坐标仍以OSM源线为准。
